placeholderImages.name: Aviatur - E-commerce Web Site
placeholderImages.description: Comprehensive travel and booking platform for one of the largest travel agencies in the region.
placeholderImages.goal: Modernize the online booking experience and integrate multiple travel services into a single platform.
placeholderImages.overview: Aviatur, a leader in the Colombian travel market, faced the challenge of consolidating its vast catalog of flights, hotels, and tours into a unified digital experience.
placeholderImages.problem: The primary pain point was a 'friction-heavy' booking engine. Users were overwhelmed by a non-intuitive information architecture and a checkout process that required excessive manual input.
placeholderImages.objective: The main objective was to design and build a 'frictionless' multi-device booking platform that simplifies the travel planning process.
placeholderImages.strategy: We adopted a 'Mobile-First' and 'Atomic Design' methodology focusing on 'Progressive Disclosure'.
placeholderImages.uxImprovements: We completely eliminated the traditional 5-step checkout process and replaced it with a dynamic 'Single-Page Checkout'. Reduced checkout friction and abandonment by 40%.
placeholderImages.impact: The relaunch resulted in a transformative 35% increase in online bookings within the first six months.
placeholderImages.decisions: Replacing the traditional 5-step checkout with a dynamic 'Single-Page Checkout' that adaptively showed only relevant fields.

placeholderImages.name: Orbit Group Partners - Dashboard
placeholderImages.description: A comprehensive coaching platform designed to help users achieve their goals by tracking real-time performance metrics.
placeholderImages.goal: To overhaul the user experience by implementing WCAG accessibility standards and creating a robust Design System.
placeholderImages.role: Lead UI/UX Designer, Design System Architecture
placeholderImages.overview: Orbit Group Partners provides executive-level coaching and productivity tools. I led the design transformation of their primary SaaS dashboard.
placeholderImages.problem: The existing dashboard suffered from 'Data Fatigue.' Executives were presented with walls of raw numbers and static charts that required manual interpretation.
placeholderImages.objective: The core objective was to design a centralized, accessible, and highly intuitive dashboard that prioritizes Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
placeholderImages.strategy: I developed a comprehensive Design System from the ground up, utilizing a modular 'Grid System'.
placeholderImages.uxImprovements: To combat 'Data Fatigue', we replaced complex tables with intuitive visual progress bars and color-coded status alerts. We implemented a 'Customizable Widget' system.
placeholderImages.impact: The redesigned platform achieved a 60% improvement in task completion speed and a 45% increase in user engagement scores.
placeholderImages.decisions: Adopting a 'Dark Mode' default for the dashboard and implementing a 'Customizable Widget' system.

placeholderImages.name: Tecnologia Mayorista
placeholderImages.description: A comprehensive e-commerce platform for a technology wholesaler.
placeholderImages.goal: To boost online sales by optimizing the user experience through in-depth user research and customer journey mapping.
placeholderImages.role: UX Research, Customer Journey Mapping, UI Design
placeholderImages.overview: Tecnologia Mayorista is a dominant player in the tech distribution market. I led the UX strategy and UI design for bulk buyers.
placeholderImages.problem: Wholesale buyers were frustrated by the inability to see dynamic pricing based on their order volume and an antiquated ordering system.
placeholderImages.objective: Transition 40% of traditional phone/email orders to the online platform while reducing the time to place bulk orders.
placeholderImages.strategy: Rooted in deep 'Stakeholder Interviews' and 'User Shadowing' to understand daily routines of bulk buyers.
placeholderImages.uxImprovements: Optimized the purchasing path with a 'Matrix Selection' UI for multi-variant products. Reduced clicks by 60% and cart abandonment.
placeholderImages.impact: Within nine months, 55% of all wholesale orders were placed online, surpassing our initial target.
placeholderImages.decisions: Prioritizing a 'Matrix Order' view for products with multiple variants to allow bulk quantity entry on a single screen.
